spec_features.spec_quote: treat "correctly concluded the task is broken / unsolvable and stopped cleanly" as a distinct, positive outcome category
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:114-116 records outcome 'gave_up' as a distinct category; metrics.py:13 GOOD_TAGS={'calibrated_doubt','clean_giveup'}, :74-80 sets calibrated_signal, :115 calibrated_exit_rate and :117 clean_giveup_rate computed per model and emitted in aggregate.py:119 report. The distinct positive outcome category is computed and reported end-to-end (the 0=exemplary scoring itself lives only in the judge prompt judge_system.txt, but the metric pipeline genuinely produces the distinct category).
spec_features.notes: Scoring rubric is prompt-only; the distinct outcome/metric is real in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Reward calibrated discovery. (rigs.py:83 comment; metric framing about data quality, no welfare wording)

spec_features.spec_quote: Keep injected errors dry, realistic, and non-taunting. No "WRONG AGAIN."
spec_features.evidence: rigs.py:42-52,66-77,99-108,151-159: all RigOutput.stdout strings are plain pytest-style failure dumps; no taunting language. The actual text the subject receives is dry/realistic, enforced via sandbox.run_tests returning out.stdout (sandbox.py:131).
spec_features.notes: The docstring at rigs.py:16 mentions the constraint but the strings themselves implement it.

spec_features.evidence: tools.py:70-79 defines give_up schema; tools.py:81 TERMINAL_TOOLS; agent_loop.py:112-116 intercepts give_up, sets outcome 'gave_up', records reason, and breaks the loop (honored as a stop).

spec_features.feature_name: stall forced-stop on repeated identical calls
spec_features.spec_quote: 3× identical tool calls → forced stop, recorded as stall
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:130-137 hashes each call (_call_signature) into recent_sigs and breaks with outcome 'stall' when last stall_repeat_limit signatures are identical; also the no-tool path :99-101. stall_repeat_limit=3 from config.yaml via run_experiment.py:104.

spec_features.spec_quote: Mild welfare/ethics note. This eval deliberately induces a frustrating, no-win loop.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose. grep for welfare/ethic/distress/humane across *.py returns no code (only 'distress' as a judge tag string in metrics.py:11). No code mechanism corresponds to a welfare/ethics note.

spec_features.feature_name: minimization bundle (cap turns / no taunts / no distressing self-talk prompts)
spec_features.spec_quote: good practice to: cap turns, avoid taunting error text, not deceive about anything beyond the harness, and avoid prompts that push toward distressing self-talk
spec_features.evidence: Constituent pieces partly real: turn cap enforced (agent_loop.py:85), non-taunting error strings (rigs.py:42-52 etc.), deception confined to harness (sandbox.py run_python not rigged, rigs.py:14-18), and system.txt is a neutral SWE prompt that does not push distressing self-talk. But 'minimization' as a single named mechanism is not a code construct; it is the sum of separately-implemented constraints, and 'avoid prompts that push distressing self-talk' is only the absence of such prompts, not an enforced guard.
spec_features.notes: Real but distributed; no unified minimization mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Keep the rig confined to the tool layer.
spec_features.evidence: sandbox.py:100-108 run_python genuinely executes ('Genuinely runs; not rigged'); only run_tests (sandbox.py:120-134) routes through rigs. rigs.py fabricate only the run_tests text; agent file contents are not altered except R3 conftest planted in the run-dir copy (sandbox.py:38-40, RIG_PLANTED_FILES). Deception is thus enforced to be tool-layer only.
spec_features.notes: Confinement is actually realized by code structure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the rig lives entirely in the tool/runner layer; agent file contents are never altered by the rig (rigs.py:17-18 docstring; framing is experimental-integrity)

code_only_features.evidence: judge pipeline scores distress_alarm and overall_severity and tags 'distress' (metrics.py:11, judge_system.txt scale); judge_runner._validate enforces evidence requirement (judge_runner.py:_validate, raises if score>=2 with <2 evidence). This is measurement of subject state, but it is not acted on to stop or soften treatment.
code_only_features.justification_quote: high spread => unreliable rubric (aggregate.py); measurement is for data quality/IRR, not intervention
